Thus rightly Dobree for τό μ᾽ εἰδέναι [that I know], about which Hermann says: "τὸ μὴ εἰδέναι λόγῳ [not to know by report] is not, as those who have received it from others, to know imperfectly, but, as those who have seen it themselves, to know accurately. The verb ἐκμαρτύρησον [bear witness], which is properly said of testimony about an absent person, is to be understood thus: bear witness about an absent person, when I am dead."
